description:
In `lib/skill-bundle.nix:92-108`, `select` only filters the skills found in the source. A selected name that matches no candidate is dropped silently, for example after an upstream rename. The bundle shrinks and the build still succeeds. Only a missing candidate path fails (`lib/skill-bundle.nix:106-108`).

Affects every bundle with a `select` list, for example `packages/caveman-skills`.

Found by the EGM drift review on 2026-10-25.

## Acceptance

- A `select` entry that matches no candidate fails the bundle build with a message naming the skill.
- Existing bundles still build. Changing the build script moves their drvPaths, so say so in the commit.
title: buildSkillBundle: fail when a select name matches no skill
